name: Noclip Death Sound
description: Mega Hack v9 addon: plays a death sound when you 'die' with noclip on.

enabled.name: Enable Death Sound
enabled.description: Play a sound every time you hit a hazard while noclip keeps you alive.

drag-drop.name: Drag & Drop Sounds
drag-drop.description: Drag any audio file (mp3, ogg, wav, flac...) onto the game window to make it the death sound.

sound-file.name: Sound File
sound-file.description: Sound to play. Easiest way: drag an audio file onto the game window. Empty = the standard GD death sound (explode_11.ogg).

respect-sfx-volume.name: Use Game SFX Volume
respect-sfx-volume.description: Multiply the volume by the in-game SFX slider.

cooldown.name: Cooldown (seconds)
cooldown.description: Minimum time between two death sounds.

contact-gap.name: Contact Gap (seconds)
contact-gap.description: Hazard contacts closer together than this are treated as one 'death'. Leave default unless sounds double up or get skipped.
